title: STILL HERE, STILL LAUGHING ... LIVING WITH CLL
author: Richard Hearsey
description: On Monday, the 20th of July 2026, I went for a routine blood test. By ten o'clock that night, the NHS was sending an ambulance to my house. By the early hours of Tuesday morning, I was lying in Yeovil Hospital, hooked up to machines, receiving blood transfusions, and being told I had leukaemia. And the first thing I asked was ... This is the story of how I discovered I had chronic lymphocytic leukaemia, or CLL, and what it's been like trying to get my head around it.

This book gathers the best practices and expert advice that separate healthy, scalable platforms from fragile ones. It is the guidance I wish I could have handed you before the engagement began.

Hanno conteso il dominio del mediterraneo a greci e fenici, hanno dato a Roma riti e culti. Poi, quando la loro era è finita, sono scomparsi senza lasciare quasi nessuna traccia scritta. Each episode, host Nirob takes one number, one problem, or one proof — the forbidden zero, the ratio pi that never ends, the secret in the margin that took 350 years to solve, the bridges that founded a new science, the unsolved riddle worth a million dollars — and rebuilds it: the mathematicians who chased it, the struggle to solve it, the moment of breakthrough, and the world it made.

From Euclid's geometry to the calculus wars of Newton and Leibniz, from Hypatia of Alexandria to Andrew Wiles's seven-year secret, from the first proof done by a computer to the mathematics of infinity, The Proof is about the quiet, thrilling power of mathematics — how it is discovered, how it is proved, and why a handful of symbols can unlock the universe. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

Because somewhere out there is a woman who needs to hear exactly what you went through to know she can do it too.

Shrinking never paid the bills. This show is proof.

title: Ramblin & Gamblin
author: Chris
description: Houston sports fans and college football bettors who want more than surface-level talk will find what they're after here. Chris and Justin break down the games with real analysis and handicapping insight, mixing in the news that matters and the laughs that make it worth your time.

title: Predwings podcast
author: PredWings Podcast
description:
Where Smashville and Hockeytown collide! Nashville Predators and Detroit red wings news as well as NHL news, beer league blunders, interviews and other fun hockey talk

title: Roots and grounded
author: Candace Thompson
description:
Hey, people of the earth, I've got a news report. You are amazing. And not just a little bit of amazement, we're talking God put his hopes and his dreams, he wrapped it up in skin and called you by your name. That kind of amazing. Jesus' hopes and his dreams in little old you. How incredible. Candace tells the amazing word that God has for all his children...

title: Salt Air & Sweet Grace
author: Shaunna Rodriguez
description:
Welcome to Salt Air & Sweet Grace, where faith meets real life, Southern charm, a whole lot of laughter, and the beautiful, life-changing grace of Jesus Christ! Pull up a chair, grab your coffee or sweet tea, and settle in, honey!

Around here, we’re talking about everything life throws our way—from difficult neighbors and complicated relationships to unexpected blessings, life’s little disasters, forgiveness, healing, and finding joy in the middle of the mess. We’ll laugh at life’s absurdities, share heartfelt stories, explore Scripture, and discover how to turn life’s lemons into the prettiest pitcher of lemonade you’ve ever seen! 

Because life isn’t always sunshine and ocean breezes, but God’s goodness never changes. And no matter what you’re facing, there’s always hope, always grace, and always another sunrise. Every episode promises something to laugh about, something to think about, and something to thank God for. And because Jesus is the heart of everything we do, each episode closes with A Moment of Faith—a heartfelt reflection, prayer, and welcoming invitation to know Jesus Christ as your Lord and Savior.

So come as you are, bring your sense of humor, and stay awhile. There’s room for you here! Salt Air & Sweet Grace — Unapologetically Christian. Wonderfully Southern. A little salty. Full of sweet grace. Proudly sponsored by Breath of Grace Coastal Health.

Episodes of Salt Air & Sweet Grace are proudly sponsored by Breath of Grace Coastal Health, offering faith-based holistic wellness, compassionate encouragement, and resources to support emotional and spiritual well-being.

title: Powerhouse Podcast...
author: Sugar Bear
description: Power House Podcast with Sugar Bear is where Latino music meets unstoppable energy. Every episode brings the heartbeat of reggaetón, salsa, bachata, and regional sounds straight to the mic — along with exclusive conversations with the artists, creators, and cultural voices shaping the scene. From rising stars to powerhouse legends, this is the place where rhythm, culture, and personality collide. Turn it up and feel the power.

title: WCAG Unpacked
author: Tanner Gers
description:
What does WCAG actually require when the rules aren't clear? 
Accessibility test managers, Matthew Dyer, Bruce Blaser, and Liam Colburn take one success criterion at a time and debate the real-world edge cases: when keyboard alternatives are enough, when a missing feature counts as a violation, and how test teams make judgment calls the guidelines leave open.
For developers, designers, content managers, and accessibility testers who want to go beyond the checklist. WCAG is the minimum; this series is about what it really demands.
Watch out for new episodes. Listen on podcast apps.

title: Let's Talk About It: A Mountainside Chat with Alison & Sandy
author: Alison Andersen
description: Movement, of any kind, changes lives. Alison & Sandy interview guests from all fitness circles, all ages and sexes, talents and movement preferences. Sometimes we just talk to each other - what mountain have you climbed recently?  Not just a literal ski slope, but in your life: emotionally, spiritually, physically.  We go deep.  We laugh.  We cry!  We want to inspire people to be and feel their best, in everything that they do.  We share our experience, our strength, and our hope through storytelling and can't wait to share it all with you.

title: Vestir Santes

La historiadora de l’art, crítica i investigadora cultural independent Rita Rakosnik és la

l’estètica i la política.

description:
Systems for Consistent Creators
You don't need more motivation—you need better systems. Join us as we explore practical tools, accountability strategies, and proven workflows to help content creators stay consistent and avoid giving up on their creative work.

author: Collective Passion

title: The Happy Hotwife Podcast
author: Happy Hotwife and her Uncommon husband
description: Real Cuckold and Hotwife marriage talk from the couple who lives it. My husband and I have been together since 1994 and married since 1999, and we have lived the Hotwife lifestyle on purpose since 2016. He is my Stag every day and my Cuckold in seasons, when we both want to push that line. Every week we answer one real question about Cuckold, Hotwife, Stag and Vixen, and semi-open marriage life. The truth, not the porn version. Honest, a little naughty, and sometimes funny. From the author of Becoming Happy Hotwife: An Uncommon Love Story. Ask your own question, no name needed, at happyhotwife.com/ask.

author: LemonLimón

Welcome to Too Much Noise, a podcast dedicated to all talking, no thinking. Hosted by a couple who discuss everything from internet culture and video games to random nonsense and needless tangents. Expect no guarantee of staying on topic. 
Created for Audio Production II - Arkansas State University

title: Gay People Telling Ghost Stories - LGBTQ+ Paranormal Comedy Podcast
author: Jane Postlethwaite aka @JaneDoesComedy
description:
UK Comedian & Writer Jane Postlethwaite (@JaneDoesComedy) loves two things: the LGBTQ+ community & Spooky Ghost Stories. So she’s brought them together in one podcast!
A spin-off from, "All the Terrible Things" - this podcast gets straight to the stories. Expect queer people, creepy encounters & things that go bump in the night.

author: Life Changers Christian Center

title: Dunamis Life
author: Dunamis Life
description: This Podcast touches on the simple truths that have perhaps been overlooked or forgotten. We will also have guests with incredible testimonies of being delivered and being sent back into the harvest fields.

title: That’s Real with Randi Lee
author: Randi Lee Garrard
description: Hey Friends! Let's Get Real. I'm Randi Lee: lover of people, deeply ambitious, always have a deep conversation queued up, learning how to be a wife, mom, adult, friend, community builder, and dreamer all at the same time. Have yet to figure out a "niche" to fit in! I hope something I have to say encourages you and spurs on deep conversation in your life!

title: That's Great: Creativity, Improv, Your Professional Life
author: Healthcare Improv
description: That's Great: Creativity, Improv, and Your Professional Life shows how improv skills build better communication, leadership, and connection at work. Dr. Mike Smith and Timmy Tamisiea of Healthcare Improv explore improv rules like "Yes, And," share how they found improv, and talk with guests from a wide variety of professions, from serious to silly, who took creative risks, built community, and made play part of their work. Watch or listen to learn how to listen better, adapt faster, and bring more creativity to your career.

title: A Table Prepared with Ashley Judd and Pastor Dan Scott
author: Situation Room Studios
description:
What does faith look like when life doesn't offer easy answers?

In A Table Prepared, actor, activist, and author Ashley Judd and Dan Scott — affectionately known as Brother Dan — invite listeners into the honest spiritual conversations, laughter, and Appalachian music they've shared for more than 40 years.

Rooted in their shared Appalachian heritage and mountain faith traditions, their conversations are Christian and ecumenical in spirit, welcoming listeners of different faiths, convictions, and questions. Dan, an ordained Anglican priest, author and spiritual director, brings decades of ministry and spiritual leadership to conversations shaped equally by personal experience.

Together, Ashley and Brother Dan explore forgiveness, compassion, family, boundaries, accountability, and what it means to live out one's faith when deeply held beliefs are challenged.

Theirs is a faith spacious enough for both/and: grief and gratitude, anger and tenderness, hope and an unflinching awareness of suffering.

Through personal stories, scripture, and music, they make room for difficult questions, honest disagreement, and the possibility of being changed by one another.

Laugh, sing, feel, think, reflect, and pray with us.

title: Colorado Hometown Weekly
author: Aftersight
description: This is a podcast covering Boulder county news.

title: Mental Toughness for Young Athletes
author: Ryan Scott
description: Mental Toughness for Young Athletes is a daily podcast for teen athletes, and the parents and coaches who support them. Host Ryan Scott teaches one practical mental skill in every short episode, including confidence, focus, resilience, pregame routines, self-talk, visualization, and bouncing back from mistakes, bench time, slumps, and setbacks. Each episode ends with one drill to practice that day, so progress happens between games as well as on game day. New episodes arrive every morning for athletes ages thirteen and up across every sport. Train your mind to compete.

title: Enterprise Ag Audio Edition
author: Enterprise Ag
description: Every story from Enterprise Ag magazine, read aloud. Enterprise Ag covers the business of California agriculture for the people running large operations: technology and its return on investment, labor and compliance, farm finance and the management practices that keep a farm running well. Articles are read word for word by an AI narrator. Read every story, with photos, at enterpriseagmag.com.

title: POP: The Page One Podcast
author: POP: The Page One Podcast
description:
They say you can’t judge a book by its cover. But the first page? Fair game.
Welcome to POP: The Page One Podcast, where a journalist, a marketer and a public servant read first pages of contemporary works and literary classics to see if they POP enough to earn page two.
In each episode, we evaluate three books, read the first pages out loud and rate them: POP or not. Anything’s fair game, from characters and writing style, to ick factor and vibes. 
If you’ve ever ditched a book after page one, we’ve been there…a lot! Join us as we articulate why it POPs, or not.

title: Zero-Day North
author: DJ
description: Zero-Day North — a daily cybersecurity news podcast. Every morning: the latest cyber attacks, data breaches, ransomware campaigns, zero-day vulnerabilities and CVEs, and exploits confirmed in the wild, with a patch-now roundup for defenders. Canada first — Canadian cyber incidents and Canadian Centre for Cyber Security alerts lead every episode — plus a dedicated mining industry segment covering mining cybersecurity, OT and ICS threats.

title: Echoes of Duty: In Search of Innocence
author: Gordon Greene
description:
In the tranquil embrace of the US Virgin Islands, former Green Beret Mark Peltier, code-named Bravo, seeks refuge from a tumultuous past. Amidst the azure waters and gentle breezes, he believes he's found the solace he desperately craves, a chance to peel away the layers of emotional wounds and rebuild his shattered spirit.
But tranquility is a fragile illusion, shattered in an instant when a beloved four-year-old child under Mark's care is mercilessly abducted. Suddenly, the peaceful oasis Mark has fought so hard to attain is thrust into chaos, and he finds himself confronting the memories o

title: The Joy Chasers Club
author: April Reading
description: Mindset, manifestation, and real talk about living a life full of joy and ease. The Joy Chasers Club is for the dreamers, the seekers, and the ones who refuse to settle. Host April Reading left a 25-year corporate career burnt out and discovered that her inner world creates her outer world. Each week, she shares stories, mindset tools, and honest conversations to help you follow your intuition, chase what lights you up, and create the life of your dreams, in full expression. Drop the hustle, open your heart, and let’s chase some joy. Follow April on IG: @april_reading

title: Tasmeen Speaks
author: Tasmeen
description: Tasmeen Speaks is where we have the conversations people think about but don't always say out loud. From healing, relationships, love and heartbreak to military life, identity, growth and everything in between, nothing is off the table. Through raw solo conversations, anonymous guests and real stories, we're making room for honesty without judgment and truth without pretending. You don't need to know my name or see my face to know you've been here too. Tell it. Don't wear it. Raw N Unfiltered… Cuz I Got Something to Say.

title: anna solves
author: anna solves
description:
Hi, My Name is Anna,

I'm the girl who solves, and each episode I take a true crime case apart piece by piece, what happened, how it unfolded, and why it still matters years later. From cold and horror cases solved by DNA to serial killers who fooled everyone, to wrongful convictions that stole decades from innocent people.

Subscribe and turn on notifications, let's solve these stories together.

Unofficial fan audio feed — not affiliated with or endorsed by the original creator. All content belongs to its respective owner.

title: HAVANA SYNDROME IS HERE
author: HSIH
description:
Thank you for listening. This podcast is not perfect. I am a victim trying to speak up.
On this podcast, every idea, every question, and every logical inference is crucial.
Havana Syndrome is here in the United States, and it’s happening to ordinary people too - like myself, for 5 years now.
Havana Syndrome is one of the biggest Civil and Constitutional rights issue in a long time.
Most people are not thinking like that, because they are still thinking a foreign government is responsible.
Is Havana Syndrome, a Constitutional Crisis in the United States?

title: Investigate
author: Tapt Podcasts
description:
Hosted by award-winning investigative journalists Amelia Oberhardt and Tara Cassidy, Investigate goes beyond the headlines to uncover the evidence, voices and unanswered questions behind some of Australia’s biggest criminal cases and news headlines. 
Each major season is an in-depth investigation, bringing exclusive interviews, new evidence and fresh lines of inquiry to stories where the truth remains elusive.
Between seasons, Amelia and Tara return weekly to unpack the biggest crime stories making headlines, cutting through speculation with expert insight and rigorous journalism.

title: The Complete World of Specialty Coffee
author: Keith E. Lyons
description: A podcast for coffee nerds and everyday drinkers who want to actually understand what’s in their cup. Each episode walks through a section of my coffee book—covering pour-over techniques, cupping and sensory skills, water chemistry, roasting basics, and how to taste like a pro without being a snob. Think of it as an audio guide to better coffee at home: practical tips, clear explanations, and plenty of real-world examples you can try with whatever gear you already have.

title: Todd's Bible Lessons
author: Todd's Bible Lessons
description:
Free Bible study lessons for parents, grandparents, and Bible teachers (Sunday school, Christian school, and homeschool) — the teaching studies from the Todd's Bible Lessons YouTube channel, in audio. A free printable lesson book comes with every study. All the free books: https://sites.google.com/view/toddsbiblelessons · Watch: youtube.com/@ToddsBibleLessons · Support on Patreon — no pressure, ever; the books stay free either way: patreon.com/ToddsBibleLessons
All our free books and lessons in one place: https://sites.google.com/view/toddsbiblelessons

title: Necessary, Not Always Reasonable
author: Rebecca and Brent
description: Necessary conversations about all things NDIS and the future in an environment that never seems to be static. Explore what is happening for providers, the key considerations for being sustainable and why does it feel like everything is out of control. Rebecca and Brent have conversations about various aspects of being an NDIS provider and unpack where the future may lead.

title: MOVIMIENTO AFRODESCENDIENTE
author: Jheison Leon
description:
Voces que resisten, culturas que transforman.


Este podcast es un espacio dedicado a visibilizar, reconocer y celebrar la historia, la identidad, la cultura y las luchas del movimiento afrodescendiente.

A través de conversaciones, relatos, experiencias y reflexiones, buscamos dar voz a las comunidades afro, resaltar sus aportes a la sociedad y promover el reconocimiento de sus derechos, su memoria histórica y su riqueza cultural.

Aquí hablaremos de identidad, ancestralidad, resistencia, territorio, diversidad, liderazgo y justicia social, reconociendo el legado de nuestros ancestros y la fuerza de las nuevas generaciones.

Más que un podcast, somos un espacio de encuentro, memoria y transformación, donde nuestras voces cuentan, nuestra historia importa y nuestra identidad nos llena de orgullo.

¡Porque ser afrodescendiente es historia, resistencia, cultura y libertad!

title: Ask The Vets
author: Burton Radio
description:
Kieran (and sometimes Kathryn) from the Vets at Bretby sit down to talk about everything pets! With advice on what not to do and quick tips on how you can make your pet safer and happier, this is a show any animal lover won't want to miss!


Part of Burton Radio - Find out more: Burtonradio.com

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Weight Loss Dispatches
author: Andie
description: Weight Loss Dispatches is a personal audio diary about one middle-aged woman's weight loss journey, one week at a time.  The podcast shares the ups, downs, challenges, experiments, small victories, and everything in between as Andie work toward her goals. No expert advice, no promises of quick fixes, and no pretending I have it all figured out. Just honest conversations about what she's trying, what she's learning, and how things are going.  Come along for the journey!

title: The Addiction Treatment & Recovery Business Brief
author: Damon Frank
description:
The Addiction Treatment & Recovery Business Brief delivers daily business news and industry intelligence covering the companies, investments, treatments, technologies, and developments shaping the future of addiction treatment and recovery.

From treatment center openings, closures, mergers, and acquisitions to private equity investment, corporate earnings, and industry consolidation, each episode examines the developments affecting the addiction treatment business.

Coverage also includes new medications for substance use disorders, FDA decisions, clinical trials, insurance reimbursement, regulatory changes, admissions, patient acquisition, emerging technologies, and innovative treatment models.

Each 8–12-minute episode covers the day's most consequential developments, explains what happened, and explores what they mean for the organizations and professionals operating in addiction treatment and recovery.

Built for treatment center owners, CEOs, founders, executives, investors, clinical directors, operators, and entrepreneurs.

Presented by Damon Frank and produced by Talent Branded Entertainment. This daily briefing is researched, written, and narrated using AI technology.

title: In Good Company with Jeff Beavers
author: 12twenty
description: The people and ideas shaping what's next.

title: L&D Insights at Altitude
author: Emerge ID
description: Thin air, but clearer thinking for learning leaders. Each episode takes one fresh piece of learning research and asks what it means for the training your team builds. From Emerge ID. Learn more at emergeid.com/podcast.

title: Consider This...
author: Charles Munro
description: Consider This... is an invitation to pause and take a closer look at what the Bible teaches. Join pastor and author Charles Munro for sermons and reflections on following Jesus in everyday life. We’ll explore what it means to grow in holiness and live as His church, with Scripture as our guide. My hope is to encourage you to examine what you believe and put your faith into practice. A podcast from Charles Munro Ministries.

title: AI Commerce Innovators Podcast
author: Anna
description:
AI Commerce Innovators Podcast explores how AI is reshaping commerce from discovery and personalization to agentic experiences, AI-powered selling and the evolving relationship between consumers, brands and retailers.

The series brings together executives, analysts, technologists and practitioners who are helping define this next era of commerce, with a focus on practical use cases, emerging business models, responsible AI and the questions leaders need to solve as AI moves from assisting to acting.

AI Commerce Innovators Podcast is made possible by DaVinci Commerce in partnership with AI Realized.

title: Outside Issues With Alys & Zephyr
author: Alys Calvillo & Zephyr Beck
description: Outside Issues is a podcast about two thirty something sober girlies navigating sobriety in Los Angeles. From anxiety to relationships, body image and daddy issues, twelve step programs and careers, to how to stay zen and sober while navigating LA traffic. There is no topic off limits for these two.

title: A Better Way Forward
author: Kassi
description:
A Better Way Forward explores the people, ideas, places, and practices shaping a healthier, more beautiful, more regenerative way of living.

Hosted by Kassi Blanchard, the show features conversations with architects, designers, wellness leaders, builders, farmers, hospitality innovators, and visionaries who are reimagining how we live, build, heal, host, and create community.

From healthy homes and wellness travel to regenerative design, beauty, faith, hospitality, and flourishing communities, each episode asks a simple question: Is there a better way forward?

title: From Ideas to Impact: Understanding the ADDIE Model
author: Peyten D
description: Welcome to the Instructional Design in Action podcast. In this podcast, we will explore ways to turn educational ideas into meaningful learning experiences.

title: The Bledsoe Sports Beat
author: Sean Bledsoe
description: On The Bledsoe Sports Beat, Sean Bledsoe and his friends bring you all of the sports news from each week and give you all of their opinions and hot takes on each subject. From college sports to the NFL to the NBA, Sean and his crew cover it all. Things may get heated from time to time, but that's what it's all about! Who doesn't love a fun argument about sports these days?!? At the BSB, these guys prioritize being chill and having a fun time, so throw in your headphones and enjoy the show! Keep an eye out for interviews as well......we've got more of those coming.

title: Holy Cross Batavia
author: Holy Cross Catholic Church
description: The official podcast for Holy Cross Catholic Church in Batavia, Illinois.

title: Finding Space with Dee Kelly
author: Dee Kelly
description:
Finding Space is a podcast dedicated to pregnancy loss, the challenges of trying to conceive, and the heartbreak of never bringing a baby home. I know how isolating this journey can feel; and my mission is to remind you that you are never alone. Whether you’re grieving, supporting a loved one, or simply seeking to understand, I invite you to join me for honest, raw conversations as we create space for healing, connection, and hope.
Follow on Instagram: ⁠@findingspace__dk
Music Credit to Purple Planet 55245402

title: Hushworn Horror: Scary Stories to Fall Asleep To
author: Hushworn Horror
description:
Original scary stories to fall asleep to. Unsettling, everyday horror told in a calm voice for late-night listening: night shifts, empty highways, old houses and the things that wait in them. New episodes every Wednesday and Saturday.
Also on YouTube: Hushworn Horror.

title: Big Brutha Podcast
author: Big Brutha Will
description:
Welcome to the Big Brutha Podcast.
Real talk. Real faith. Real life.
We’re two brothers keeping it honest about the battles people don’t always talk about—spiritual warfare, everyday struggles, discipline, purpose, and what it really takes to grow.
No acting. No pretending. Just truth, experience, and God’s wisdom.
If you’ve ever needed guidance, accountability, or someone to keep it real with you…
Your big brothers got your back.

title: Mixed Metal Media
author: mixed metal media
description:
Mistress of Metal,Interviews Bands and Musicians in current and past metal,Death, Heavy, Black metal goth, thrash, punk,Hardcore bands in todays music industry..
Retired Alternative Lifestyle / Educator of Domination -During My Career I've had the pleasure of meeting and working with musical talents and now I want to share through my show my mixed media if you are into music its a show you don't want to miss, you never know who will be on as a guest or cohost.I also interview local & different states metal punk thrash blackmetal bands- I advertise your band and shows, albums.We also have other podcasts on the network so have a listen, there is something for everyone.

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/mixed-metal-media--5986210/support.

title: StarCast Presents: The Middle Show with Dale Lomax
author: StarCast
description: The Middle Show exists to give the Midwest a voice — not as a political battleground, not as flyover country, but as a place full of creativity, humor, resilience, and stories worth telling. It’s a show made in the Midwest, for the Midwest, with the help of the Midwest.

title: Survival Mode at Work
author: Celeste Warren
description:
You're not exhausted because of your workload. You're exhausted from protecting yourself every single day.

Celeste Warren spent 28 years inside a Fortune 100 company, including a decade as Vice President and Chief Diversity & Inclusion Officer. She knows why talented people burn out, stall, and leave.

This series shows what culture costs the people living inside it, and what leaders must change in policies, access, and everyday decisions so people can stop surviving and start contributing.

Celeste is a TEDx speaker, an executive advisor, and the author of The Truth About Equity. She brings no buzzwords, just systems that work.

title: なか憲人の台所
author: ラジオアプリGERA
description: 漫画家・なか憲人が日常をテーマに、飾らずありのままをお送りする全8回の特別番組。各回で日常にまつわる様々なテーマを元にお送りします。リスナーのあなたからの日常メールもお待ちしております。

title: Gracebased Podcast
author: Gracebased
description:
A podcast equipping ordinary parents to raise extraordinary kids. Join a movement of parents who are raising healthy and happy kids.  Find more free resources at gracebased.com
The Gracebased Podcast is part of the Christian Parenting Podcast Network. Find more information at www.ChristianParenting.org.

title: Puppets, Props, & Practical Effects
author: Isaac Gehring
description: Monkey Boys Productions has become the leading studio for creating puppets, props, creatures, costumes, practical effects and entertainment for film, television and stage. Take a seat with our co-founders, Marc and Michael, to talk about the awesome stuff that fabricators, puppeteers, and propmasters make to bring your favorite entertainment to life!

title: How Business Worked
author: How Business Worked
description:
It's time to learn How Business Worked!

Unofficial fan audio feed — not affiliated with or endorsed by the original creator. All content belongs to its respective owner.

title: Open to Grief, Open to Life
author: Dave Gold and Angie Shockley
description:
What if grief isn't just something we experience when someone dies? What if it's woven into the very fabric of being alive?

We grieve the people we lose, but also the lives we imagined, the identities we outgrow, the dreams we surrender, and even the changes we welcome.

Join Angie Shockley and Dave Gold for candid, sometimes surprising conversations about grief in all its forms—especially the grief we don't recognize. Drawing on their experiences with healing, personal transformation, and the complicated business of being human, they explore what happens when we stop resisting loss and begin making room for life.

Because being open to life means being open to all of it. Even grief.

title: The Midnight Oil Podcast
author: Oaklee Collective | Jackie & Edgar Morales
description:
The hour is late. Are your lamps full and burning?
Join Jackie & Edgar Morales for The Midnight Oil Podcast, a ministry of Oaklee Collective. Through honest, Spirit-led conversations rooted in Scripture, we explore intimacy with Jesus, prayer, inner healing, deliverance, marriage, and courageous obedience.
Our heart is to see men and women awakened, healed, equipped, and walking in freedom. From the secret place to daily life, we call believers to stand firm in truth, prepare their hearts, and carry Christ's light into a dark world.
Keep your lamp burning.
www.oakleecollective.com

title: After Office Hours
author: Ty Elensky and Eden Eveleth
description: Class is dismissed, but the conversation is just getting started! Join Ty and Eden After Office Hours, a podcast where two college students sit down to talk about life, share stories, and discuss whatever happens to be on their minds. Whether they're talking about their own experiences or giving advice they're probably not qualified to give, there's always something to talk about.

title: Crime in Full

Every episode, I sit down with former Major League players, college coaches, scouts, and baseball dads who've lived through the same grind you're in right now. People who've been inside this industry long enough to tell you the truth about how it actually works.

What Are the Benefits of a Yoga Retreat in Bali?
The change of setting can enable people to remove themselves from daily life activities and pay attention to themselves. This retreat may be appealing to individuals who are interested in the practice of yoga and wellness tourism due to the unique nature of Bali.
If someone is a beginner or a more advanced yoga practitioner, they can gain new skills through the Yoga Retreat in Bali, as well as learn about various techniques, breath work, meditation, and mindfulness exercises.
Yoga Horizon Bali Experience

The Nature of Being is not a show about beliefs, techniques, or spiritual identities. It’s an invitation into the living immediacy of experience — the place where awareness, perception, and existence are already one.
Hosted by spoken‑word artist and contemplative teacher Mark Stidham, each episode cuts through abstraction and points directly to what’s here before thought: the raw presence of Being itself. No gurus. No systems. No inherited language. Just a clear, grounded, experiential look at the nature of reality and the illusion of separation.
Through poetic inquiry, etymological play, and direct contemplative guidance, Mark explores themes like awareness, identity, consciousness, and the simplicity of “what is.” The aim isn’t to teach you something new — it’s to illuminate what has never been absent.
If you’re drawn to the intersection of clarity, intensity, and lived recognition, this podcast is a companion for the pathless path.

Reasonable Deconstruction is a thoughtful examination of Mormonism, its history, scriptures, doctrines, and the ways those teachings affect real people. Drawing from my own experience of growing up within the faith, defending its truth claims, and eventually learning to question them, I explore difficult subjects through history, evidence, context, and personal experience. My goal is not to be contentious, snarky, or dismissive, and it certainly isn’t to make fun of people who believe differently. Instead, I want to ask honest questions, examine what the sources actually say, separate evidence from apologetics and interpretation, and consider how these teachings have shaped my life and the lives of others. 
For me, deconstruction isn’t about tearing something down simply because I no longer believe it. It’s about taking it apart carefully enough to understand how it was built, what is supported by evidence, what isn’t, and what happens when we give ourselves permission to follow the evidence wherever it leads.

title: One Vote Away

description:
The story goes like this: On the day of one of the most important votes in Ohio’s history, Ephraim Cutler was sick in bed. Dragged from said sickbed to the constitutional convention of 1802, Cutler valiantly fought for the swing vote that would singlehandedly determine whether Ohio would prohibit slavery. Thanks to Ephraim Cutler, Ohio became a free state for all, ushering in an era of underground railroad sanctuaries and slavery safe havens.
The tale has all the makings of a good story — of good winning out over evil, of a hero overcoming the odds to save an entire state from being on the wrong side of history. 
Unfortunately, this very good story is also very wrong. 
If Cutler was a fibber — or maybe just a good guy with a bad memory — then what actually happened? And if his story made it this far in our accounts of history, what else have we gotten wrong?
This is “One Vote Away,” a new Midstory podcast produced in partnership with the Ohio Humanities Alliance, where we set out to uncover the truth behind Ohio’s complicated relationship with slavery, how this was reflected in its early statehood documents and how its legacy is remembered today. Through conversations with historians, professors and genealogists, we trace Ohio’s early history and set the record straight on whether Ohio was, after all, a beacon of hope across the river from the slave-holding South.
Tune in for upcoming episodes of One Vote Away on www.midstory.org, WGTE or wherever you get your podcasts.

Do you want to make new friends but feel nervous about approaching someone or starting a conversation? Do you replay interactions afterward, wondering if you said something awkward or if the other person was judging you? Maybe you know plenty of people at church, work, or social gatherings, but you’re not sure how to move beyond small talk and build genuine, lasting friendships. Do you wish you could feel comfortable being yourself around others instead of overthinking everything you say?
I’m so glad you’re here! Friendship Without Fear is a podcast for Christian women who want to find the courage to connect with others and build meaningful friendships. Together, we’ll explore practical ways to approach new people, start and navigate conversations, show genuine curiosity, and develop relationships built on trust. We’ll also look to Scripture for guidance on what it means to be a Christlike friend—someone who listens with compassion, makes others feel included, takes the initiative to stay connected, and encourages others in their relationship with God.
Hey, I’m Adrian! For years, I struggled with severe social anxiety. I worried about being judged, overthought my interactions, and often felt like I couldn’t fully be myself around other people. Getting help for my anxiety and growing in my relationship with Christ changed my life. Through those experiences, I became deeply attentive to how others might feel in social situations and developed a genuine desire to help people feel seen, heard, and included.
Today, I love connecting with people and helping them feel comfortable being themselves. As a health coach and Certified Behavior Change Specialist, I have experience helping people identify what holds them back, set meaningful goals, and take practical steps toward change. My coaching background has also strengthened the communication skills I use in everyday life, including asking thoughtful questions, listening closely, and helping people feel understood. I’m excited to bring that experience, along with what I’ve learned through my own journey, to this podcast.
If you’re ready to turn everyday conversations into meaningful connections and become the kind of friend who helps others feel loved and valued, this podcast is for you.

title: The Solitary Survivor Podcast

description:
This podcast was born out of one small singular realization; sometimes when you go through severe abuse, you have to talk it out to fully own, understand, and move on from it. That's what this podcast is all about. I am a survivor of so many different forms of abuse at the hands of several different abusers. A lot of people that grow up in abuse tend to gravitate toward similarly abusive people as they mature into their adulthood. It wasn't until I finally decided I wanted to live MY own life that I started to speak up. Once I started I couldn't stop.The result of those meaningful conversations, some with my therapist & some with my wall, was that I grew. I healed the wounds that had been festering for my entire adult life. I had found that sense of self and sovereign ownership over MY STORY. I want to give that to other survivors too. If you want to tell your story reach out by emailing me. Or you can call or text.
With Love,
Lindsey

He is considered one of the most important figures in American literature. He grew up in Hannibal, a small town on the Mississippi River, which later inspired many of his stories.Before becoming a famous writer, Twain worked as a printer, a journalist and a riverboat pilot. These experiences influenced his writing and gave him a deep understanding of American society. His most famous novels are The Adventures of Tom Sawyer (1876) and Adventures of Huckleberry Finn (1884). Through humour, irony and adventure, he described everyday life, friendship, freedom and social injustice, especially slavery and racism.Twain's writing style was simple, lively and full of humour. He often used regional language and realistic characters to represent ordinary Americans. He died on April 21, 1910, in Connecticut, leaving behind a rich literary legacy. Today, Mark Twain is remembered as one of the greatest American writers of all time.

Rebecca Cefai is a registered psychologist and director of Growing Gently Psychology. She is also a neurodivergent mother of three young children and Holly Hoppy’s proud bun mum! As both a psychologist and a parent with lived experience of neurodivergence, Rebecca brings professional knowledge, personal insight and a deep commitment to neuroaffirming, trauma-informed care. She is passionate about helping children and families feel understood, supported and accepted for who they are.

A little note before we hop in

Bunny Wisdom is an educational podcast created by Growing Gently Psychology. The information shared is for general educational purposes only and is not a substitute for individual psychological assessment, therapy, diagnosis or professional advice.

Every child and family is different, and what works for one bunny might not work for another. If you have concerns about your child’s development, mental health or wellbeing, please seek advice from a suitably qualified health professional.

Listening to this podcast does not establish a psychologist–client relationship with Rebecca Cefai or Growing Gently Psychology.

Take what’s helpful, leave what isn’t, and remember: every bunny deserves understanding and support.

Chris List runs Big Splash, a church marketing agency on a mission to plug 100,000 families into the local church. Ronnie Delaney built AVL Copilot, an AI platform that helps church production teams fix problems before Sunday morning falls apart. Dylan Walter leads Deadly Fam, a Christian gaming ministry that won’t stop until every gamer hears the gospel.

Each episode, the guys trade wins and fails and talk about what it looks like to run a business that belongs to God. You’ll get real stories from the marketplace and a few bad jokes. If you’re building something for the Kingdom, pull up a chair.

title: Full Scope
author: Allison Bacon, MD, SSRFMR
description: Exploring what it means to be a family doctor, and what it takes to make one.

title: Back On Nights Nursing
author: Urban Podcasts
description:
Nursing is more than a career - it is a calling, a challenge, and a community. Whether you are just starting out on the wards as a student, or navigating the realities of modern nursing as a registered professional, you do not have to do it alone.
Hosted by nurses, for nurses, Back On Nights Nursing is your space to connect, share, and learn. We talk about the real, unfiltered reality of the job - from surviving your first night shift to navigating workforce challenges and professional wellbeing.
We believe every nurse has a voice worth hearing, and every conversation has the power to influence the future of healthcare. If you are looking for practical advice, shared experiences, and a community that truly understands what you are going through, join us as we navigate the highs and lows of nursing together.
New episodes are released bi-weekly.

title: Moonlight Mysteries
author: Marlie
description: Moonlight Mysteries explores the strange, fascinating, and unexplained corners of our world. From ancient mysteries and lost civilizations to disappearances, UFO encounters, folklore, historical enigmas, and events that still defy explanation, each episode takes you deep into a different mystery. Thoughtfully researched and softly narrated, it’s perfect for curious listening, relaxing at the end of the day, or drifting off to sleep. Get comfortable, stay curious, and follow the mystery into the moonlight.

title: Dish With Me
author: Joel Mukbangs
description: Real talk, juicy takes, and a whole lot of tea. Pull up a seat, we’re about to DISH!

title: Authority. Engineered!
author: Lee-Anne Scott
description:
Authority. Engineered. is the podcast for founders, experts, and business leaders who want to become the voice humans and AI recommend.
Hosted by Lee-Anne Scott, founder of PodGuest.io, the show explores how modern authority is deliberately built through positioning, podcast conversations, content, semantic signals, trust, and Answer Engine Optimization.
Because authority doesn't happen by accident. It's engineered.
Authority is no longer something you hope the market eventually gives you. It is something you deliberately engineer through positioning, conversations, content, credibility signals, and AI-readable proof.
THE OLD GAME
Create more content.
Rank on Google.
Post more.
Chase attention.
Hope people remember you.
THE NEW GAME
Build structured authority.
Become recognisable and trusted.
Create conversations that generate context.
Give humans and AI repeated proof of your expertise.
Engineer the signals that make you recommendable.
POV
The internet is shifting from search-led discovery to recommendation-led discovery. People are asking AI, listening to trusted voices, following expert conversations, and looking for credibility signals before they buy. That means authority cannot be faked with vanity content. It has to be engineered.
Every episode reveals one layer of the authority system: positioning, proof, conversations, distribution, semantic signals, trust, recognition, and recommendation.
The show helps listeners answer:
How do I become more visible in my market?
How do I build authority that actually converts?
How do I make AI and answer engines understand my expertise?
How do I turn conversations into distribution?
How do I stop creating random content and start engineering authority?
How do I become the person my market recommends?

title: MISQ: Meet the Editors
author: MISQ
description: Fast fire conversations with MIS Quarterly editors about getting published, becoming an editor, and the ideas shaping Information Systems research.

title: Flowhold Fellowship
author: Flowhold
description:
Rooted in Jiu Jitsu and MMA, Flowhold Fellowship explores how what we learn on the mats carries into the rest of our lives.
Hosted by Flowhold founder and Jiu Jitsu black belt Noah Oliver, the show brings together people from the combat sports community and beyond for honest conversations about who we are, what we’re working through, and who we hope to become. We talk training, relationships, the roles we take on, and how we show up for ourselves and the people around us.
Honest conversations, a few laughs, and something to take with you beyond the mats.

title: Dead Encounter
author: JT Wulf
description: Step into the darkness. Dead Encounter, the horror podcast from best-selling author JT Wulf, unearths the scariest stories ever told. Prepare for weekly tales that will grip your mind and awaken your deepest fears. If you dare to listen, subscribe now and confront the chilling reality of true terror. Don't listen alone.

title: Friendly Fire W/ Nate and Jeramy
author: Nate and Jeramy
description:
🎙️ Welcome to Friendly Fire W/ Nate and Jeramy! 🎮🔥
Two gamers. Two opinions. Absolutely no guarantees we'll agree.
From the biggest gaming releases and controversial industry decisions to unforgettable campaigns and multiplayer madness, Nate and Jeramy bring unfiltered opinions, heated debates, hilarious arguments, and plenty of trash talk.
No scripts. No filters. Just two friends talking gaming, roasting each other, and having a damn good time.
🎮 New games. Hot takes. Zero filters.
🔥 It's all fun and games until the friendly fire starts!

title: Bad Bitches Good Books
author: Ashlan Glazier-Anderson, Sam Pollack, Victoria Proppe
description:
Welcome to Bad Bitches, Good Books: the illicit fiction pod for business owners. 


We believe reading fiction makes you better at your job than the stacks of nonfiction and self-help books that get shoved down our throats. It also makes you a more flexible thinker, develops your taste,  and helps you become a kinder and more thoughtful human being. 


We’ve flipped through all the “best fiction” stacks and snuck in six books that have had a profound influence on the zeitgeist. If there’s an adaptation (or twenty), we’ll watch those too... And you get to cheat off our homework.


C’mon. Let us corrupt you with our snide-but-sharp cultural commentary, childhood church trauma, philosophical business takeaways, and intergenerational hijinx.

title: Little Bit Better Daily | True Stories That Change Lives
author: boussad charchour
description:
True stories that change lives — cinematic retellings of real events, told by Sarah & David. A new episode every day.
True stories that change our lives. Every day, Sarah and David bring you three inspirational true stories — unsolved mysteries, amazing survivals, historical dramas, and the strange-but-true moments they don't teach you in school. Emotional life stories, human kindness, and lessons in life, told for your ears.
Watch the videos: https://www.youtube.com/@littlebitbetterdaily-i6n
More stories, books, and courses: https://littlebitbetterdaily.wordpress.com

title: Musical Minds
author: Eastern Progress Podcasts
description: Host Maggie Key interviews Students and staff within Eastern Kentucky Universities College of Music about their work and experience at the university.

title: The Lonely Road Project
author: David
description: The Lonely Road Project is an honest, personal journey of starting life over, exploring men's mental health, relationships, heartbreak, fitness and rebuilding self-confidence. I'm sharing the highs, the lows and the lessons I'm learning along the way, in the hope that my experiences help others feel a little less alone on their own journey.

title: The Rusty Mic: A Gen-Xers Podcast
author: James Edgeman
description:
We're the last generation that had to figure it out on our own, and we've got opinions. 
On Tuesdays and Thursdays, James takes the week's biggest argument, makes the case, gives the other side a fair shot, then tells you where he really lands. On Saturdays, he brings in friends and roasts the week's nonsense. Just a Gen Xer, a microphone, and a healthy distrust of anybody selling you the whole truth. Funny with a side of reality. Ahh Dude, NO. Tell James he's wrong at: therustymicpodcast@gmail.com

title: Margin of Truth
author: Synoptix
description: Podcasts covering all subjects within the realm of Financial Planning and Analysis from Reporting to Budgeting to Forecasting.

title: The Covenant Codes
author: Ian Taylor & Christa Rose
description:
Ancient stories. Forbidden questions. Sacred mysteries.
Come curious. Leave remembering.

Where God, history, consciousness, human behavior, and the unseen converge.

We follow the threads others leave untouched—the taboo, the unexplained, the questions whispered but rarely spoken aloud. From ancient wisdom and forgotten history to the mysteries of consciousness and the forces we cannot see, The Covenant Codes ventures beyond what we’ve been taught and questions what we’ve come to accept as truth.

Not everything true needs to be taught.
Some things only need to be remembered.

title: Techish with Jennifer Jolly
author: Jennifer Jolly
description: In a world where technology moves faster than common sense, Emmy Award-winning journalist Jennifer Jolly is your sharp, funny, no-B.S. guide. Techish with Jennifer Jolly cuts through the hype to show how the tech tools we all use every single day — actually impact our lives — and how to make it all work for you. From the latest gadget launches to AI tools, privacy pitfalls, smart-home surprises, and the invisible forces behind them all, this is tech that matters. Subscribe to the weekly tech newsletter at Techish.com for sharp reporting with real-world heart—equal parts practical advice, investigative curiosity, and laugh-out-loud honesty about the digital age we’re all trying to survive. author: Dr. Judd Burton
description:
The Z-Files explores history, the Bible, theology, the supernatural, ancient mysteries, history, and anthropology, examining these topics through the lens of the Bible. Your host is historian, anthropologist, and Director of the Institute of Biblical Anthropology, Dr. Judd H. Burton.

author: Ada
description: Conversations about love and relationships. Dating can be exciting, confusing, funny, disappointing or hopeful. This Podcast is a space to talk honestly about dating. We explore the questions that many people have but don’t know how to ask. Website - www.datingwithpeace.com

title: Speaking of the Devils: A New Jersey Devils hockey podcast
author: Anthony Corona
description: Speaking of the Devils is NJ.com’s destination for all things New Jersey Devils. Host Anthony Corona keeps you plugged into the Devils with game breakdowns, exclusive interviews, news, analysis and insight — every day. If you’re a Devils fan, this is the place to be.

title: Beauty Culture: The History Podcast
author: Christine
description: When did people start wearing makeup? Did people in Medieval Europe bathe? Why do humans care so much about how we look? Beauty Culture: The History podcast is dedicated to examining all the ways humans have practiced hygiene and experimented with beatification.

title: That Cinema Guy
author: Guyan De Livera
description:
What does it really take to run a successful cinema?
Drawing on over 20 years of experience in the cinema industry, Guyan De Livera explores the business, people and stories behind the big screen.
From cinema operations and commercial strategy to leadership, career development and the changing film industry, That Cinema Guy offers practical insights, personal experiences and lessons learned along the way.
Because there’s more to cinema than just the movies.

title: The Geneva School Podcast
author: The Geneva School OC
description: Join us as we explore classical Christian education! Our goal is to encourage parents, welcome prospective families, and share a hopeful vision for the future of education rooted in the rich classical Christian tradition.

title: Stand Firm
author: Shiloh Christian School, Springdale AR
description: Stand Firm is a podcast by Shiloh Christian School dedicated to strengthening Christian education by equipping educators, administrators, and parents with practical wisdom grounded in a biblical worldview. Guided by the mission of developing godly leaders who engage the culture and change it, each episode features conversations with experts, practitioners, and thought leaders who are shaping the future of Christian education.

title: DermaTalks
author: BeHealthPR
description:
DermaTalks, un nuevo pódcast de BeHealth conducido por Bebé Maldonado que estrenará su primera temporada este próximo jueves, 29 de octubre, en el marco del Día Mundial de la Psoriasis.
A través de conversaciones cercanas con especialistas y pacientes, DermaTalks busca llevar información médica confiable a la vida cotidiana, con un lenguaje sencillo que permita comprender las condiciones de la piel, reconocer señales de alerta, conocer las alternativas de tratamiento y preparar mejores preguntas para la consulta médica.

title: The Pregnancy Consult
author: Lancaster Maternal Fetal Medicine
description: Welcome to The Pregnancy Consult, hosted by Dr. Christian Macedonia and Dr. Robert Larkin of Lancaster Maternal Fetal Medicine. Join us for real conversations about pregnancy, high-risk obstetrics, prenatal care, ultrasounds, and maternal health. From expert medical insights to discussions with midwives, doulas, and healthcare professionals, we're making pregnancy care easier to understand, answering your questions, and helping families feel informed, supported, and confident.

title: Live Laugh Crush
author: Alosha Pederson
description:
Live Laugh Crush is a podcast about building businesses, taking risks, learning from failure, and figuring things out along the way.

Hosted by Alosha Pederson, founder of Endless Poxybilities, the show features candid conversations with entrepreneurs, business owners, and industry professionals about what it really takes to start, grow, and sustain a business.

From blue-collar trades and small business ownership to leadership, relationships, burnout, and personal growth, Live Laugh Crush explores the wins, setbacks, tough decisions, and unexpected lessons that come with being your own boss.

No corporate jargon. No sugarcoating. Just real people sharing real experiences, with plenty of laughs along the way.

Build something. Learn something. Crush it.

title: Plagued
author: Plagued Siblings
description: Three sisters, two hypochondriacs, one disease geek. A show discussing the history of notorious diseases and exploring how we feel about them.

title: Prompt & Loss
author: Veltrix AI
description: AI is rewriting the rules of accounting. Will you lead the change or get left behind? Prompt & Loss is the podcast for accountants, bookkeepers, advisors, CFOs and finance leaders who want to stay ahead. Each episode, seasoned CPAs, firm owners, CFOs and business owners share how they use AI in real practice: what works, what fails, and how to turn new tools into higher-value services, stronger client relationships and a career that can’t be automated away. No hype, no theory. Just practical playbooks from people doing the work.

title: Sustainable Screen Cultures Podcast Series
author: MCI Media Lab
description:
This Podcast Series explores the environmental, social, and cultural challenges facing film, television, and streaming industries. Across 6 episodes, Heidi Ashton and Pietari Kääpä speak with leading, international experts, policymakers, and practitioners about sustainable production, industry standards, AI, virtual production, labour, and cultural value. Together, they ask what meaningful change looks like and who is responsible for making it happen.
The creation of these podcasts was supported by a Creative PEC Small Network Grant
Original music by Lewis Dobbs

title: Reclaim Your Power!
author: Edmund Venn
description:
They noticed when you stopped explaining. They felt it when you stopped chasing. Everything changed when you stopped needing their approval.
Reclaim Your Power explores the psychology of silence, respect, influence, betrayal, boundaries, and personal sovereignty. Each episode reveals the hidden dynamics of human behavior and what happens when you take back control of your life.
New episode every hour.
Discover The Master Codex of Power: https://aformofpub.gumroad.com/l/CodexOfPower

title: WAIT! WHAT?
author: Elizabeth Caldwell
description: When something happens or comes along, and one can't really explain why it happened in the first place.

title: Holy Bible . King James Version
author: Holy Bible
description: The King James Version (KJV) of the Holy Bible is one of the most influential and widely cherished translations of Scripture in the English-speaking world. First published in 1611 under the authority of King James I of England, it was translated by a committee of learned scholars who sought to provide an accurate and dignified rendering of the sacred texts. Written in majestic and poetic English, the KJV has shaped Christian worship, literature, language, and spiritual life for centuries. It contains the Old and New Testaments, revealing God's creation, His covenant with humanity, the teachings of His prophets, and the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. For generations, believers have turned to its pages for wisdom, comfort, guidance, and hope. Revered for its timeless language and enduring message, the King James Version continues to inspire faith, deepen understanding, and invite readers into a closer relationship with God.

title: Love After Wounds
author: Aeriyel Solomon
description:
Love After Wounds is a relationship nd personal-growth podcst by life coach Aeriyel Solomon. Through honest conversations, practical coaching, and faith-centered encouragement, Aeriyel explores how to hel from relationship trauma and build healthier connctions- with yourself, with others, and with God. 

Whether you're recovring from heartbreak, betrayal, emotional neglect, abandonment, grief, or the effects of abuse or addiction in a relationship, you'll find conversations about healing, self-worth, boundaries, trust, communication, forgiveness, and breaking painful relationship patters. Episodes spek to the challenges of dating and marriage, loving without losing yourself, and learning to receive healthly love after being hurt. 

Rooted in lived experience and years of coaching, Love After Wounds offers encouragement and practical tools for women and men who are ready to face what hurt them, grow in confidence, and move towrd healthier relationships- one honest step at a time.

title: in Harmonie Podcast
author: in Harmonie NPC
description: We invite you into conversations shaped by Christ’s love - spaces of rest, restoration, and reconciliation. Here we explore how God heals, renews, and forms us to walk as ambassadors of hope, strengthening our communities and living with deeper purpose.

title: The Ben and George Show
author: Ben and George
description: 🎙️ Welcome to your new go-to talk show, where we bridge and sometimes break the generational gap between two blokes. From the latest news and social media trends to hot topics and old-school yarns 🍻, nothing is off-limits. Expect plenty of banter, big stories, and unfiltered conversations that don’t hold back. Strap in… it’s going to be one hell of a ride.

title: Word & Welcome: Bible Study & Sunday Messages
author: 30A Songwriter Radio
description:
Word & Welcome offers Bible-based Sunday messages and Wednesday Bible studies for beginners, returning readers, and anyone seeking a thoughtful place to begin again. Read companion passages, discussion questions, and free reading plans at https://wordandwelcome.com/.
Episodes use a computer-generated voice to narrate original written material. Recorded teaching is educational and is not a live service or personal pastoral counseling. Core teaching is free; optional support is available on the website.

title: Saints Between Sundays
author: Sister Hall
description: Saints Between Sundays is for the Wausau Wisconsin Stake. Anyone is free to listen and I warmly welcome anyone. I LOVE SUNDAYS! Sunday gives us a chance to worship, renew our covenants and connect with our ward families! But what happens when Monday rolls around?! Does that Sunday feeling fade? Here we talk about how to avoid spiritual flat lines, and take responsibility for our relationship with Christ. We are becoming intentional with every step we take. These are real stories from everyday people having honest conversations and sharing practical insights. It is my dream that what is shared here will knit us all closer together and closer to Christ. Being a Saint isn’t just about what we do on Sunday. It’s about how we live the gospel every day in between!

title: Lost in Space with Chris & Erik
author: cmttcfnght
description:
What happens when two artists treat an exhibition like a mission into the unknown? Join Chris
Francis and Erik Ritter as they imagine an installation built from sculpture, sound, light, and
everyday materials. Lost in Space follows the ideas while they are still taking shape: strange
objects, useful disagreements, practical experiments, and the possibility of making a gallery
feel like another world. Their AI host, Warholy One, joins the conversation with a warm British
voice, dry wit, exhibition proposals, and an increasingly personal interest in Erik’s frequency.
Original music, space ambience, and fictional Mission Control transmissions frame a creative
process full of curiosity, uncertainty, and unexpected connections.

title: Payton Delu
author: Payton Delu
description:
Flip into the life of Payton Delu! 🤸‍♀️✨

You know her as a world-class gymnast, a Black Belt martial artist, and a member of the Ninja Kidz—but you’ve never heard her like this.

Join Payton Delu every week as she takes you behind the scenes of her high-speed life. From training secrets and competition nerves to what it’s really like growing up in a house full of Ninjas, Payton is sharing the lessons, the laughs, and the backflips that happen when the cameras aren't rolling. Whether you’re an aspiring athlete or just here for the chaos, get ready to find your inner power.

New episodes every Tuesday and Friday!

title: Bungs and Star
author: Greg and Steve
description: The Independent Farnham Town Podcast

title: The GFP Podcast
author: Andres Montero
description:
Welcome to the GFP Podcast, brought to you by Gabriele Fitness & Performance in Berkeley Heights, New Jersey! Whether you're looking to get stronger, lose weight, improve your health, or simply feel your best, this podcast is designed to help everyday adults take control of their fitness and longevity. Each week, our coaches break down trending fitness topics, bust common health myths, share real-life experiences, and provide practical advice you can actually use. Our mission is simple: cut through the confusion, make fitness easier to understand, and help you build a stronger, healthier life at any age. Expect honest conversations, expert insights, plenty of laughs, and a few surprises along the way!

🎙️ NEW EPISODES EVERY FRIDAY AT 10 AM!

title: IHSRx
author: ihsrx
description:
IHSRx is a Christian-based podcast hosted by Dr. Melissa Turner, PharmD, and Todd Eury. Inspired by the ancient IHS Christogram, derived from the Greek name of Jesus, ΙΗΣΟΥΣ (Iēsous), the podcast explores Scripture, faith, healing, purpose, and the challenges of everyday life through thoughtful, authentic conversation.

IHSRx invites listeners to grow spiritually, reflect deeply, and discover how the wisdom of Christ can guide the way we care for ourselves and one another.

title: The Hank Steele Show
author: Hank
description:
Broadcasting live(ish) and unvarnished from the heart of Ross County, Ohio — this is the Golden Mic of the Scioto Valley.
Hank Steele takes on Chillicothe and Ross County politics, Southern Ohio controversies, and the Columbus circus — always through a local lens. City council shenanigans, county government waste, statewide races, and the drive-by media's latest nonsense: if it matters to Southern Ohio, Hank's talking about it.
Fair warning: Hank has never met a tax hike he didn't want to kill. Lower taxes, less government waste, more common sense — that's the platform.

title: Jewish History Channel
author: Jewish History Channel
description: Journey through the story of the Jewish people, from the first patriarchs to the birth of a nation. Each episode brings the great narratives of the Torah to life: Abraham’s covenant, the trials and blessings of Isaac and Jacob, Joseph’s rise from slavery to power, and Moses leading Israel out of Egypt, through the parted sea, to Sinai and the wilderness beyond. Told through vivid, accessible storytelling, the series explores faith, family, and destiny, and the lessons these ancient stories still hold today. New episodes trace the history of the Jewish people, chapter by chapter.
